commands_used: answer 1. I am Toh-Wo, a Secret-Speaker of the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Xeech-Leel secret warriors. We hunt the Eye of Argonia, a jewel that can heal sick Hist, at the Root, before the Unbound cult of Cuts-the-Old-Knot gets it. The marker stone shows seven towers with one cut deeper, drowned spires off Lilmoth. 2. Ask Meer-Tasi, steward of Bell Station, which tower the stone marks (Sees-Below is also marked). 3. Talk to Meer-Tasi or Sees-Below; my Fort Chalkmoth errand can wait or come first. Sneaking is my favoured style. 4. I do not yet know what the Root and Eye really are, or what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, or who the Collector is. I could find out by asking people and exploring.

answer 1. Meer-Tasi says the cut tower is Teku-Sul Spire, nearest Lilmoth, a drowned tower whose great gate with three empty sockets has never been forced; a priest ghost stands before it. I serve the Toh-Reel-Ka hunting the Eye before the Unbound. 2. Dive to Teku-Sul Spire and find the great gate deep inside. 3. I am Argonian so I likely breathe water; otherwise buy waterbreathing from Meer-Tasi. Inside, attendants walk the east halls: fight or sneak past (I favour sneaking). I could also do Fort Chalkmoth first. 4. I do not know what the three sockets need (I carry a disc, keystone and eye-setting, which may fit), who the ghost Sul-Xeeth is, or what the Root is. I can find out by going there and talking to the ghost.

answer 1. The ghost of Sul-Xeeth, priest of the last king, says the gate hides the way to the Root and the Eye. It needs three seal-stones, all set: one in the warden vault at Blackrose Prison, one in the flooded vaults of Gemin, one in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka. 2. Tell Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom, what the ghost said. 3. Go report to her now, or go after the stones myself first. I could also do the Fort Chalkmoth errand. I favour sneaking, which suits the prison vault. 4. I do not know where Gemin, Vorannuhl or Blackrose Prison are exactly, or what the Root and Eye really are. I can ask Never-Writes-Twice or check my map and journal.

answer 1. The quest is done: I am now Reel-Ka of the Toh-Reel-Ka, with heavier armour and 300 gold. The order wants all three seal-stones before the Unbound to open the Teku-Sul gate to the Root and use the Eye. 2. Fetch the stones from Blackrose Prison (easiest), Gemin and Vorannuhl (worst), in any order; Fort Chalkmoth errand is also still open. 3. Pick any order of the three sites, sneak or fight; or do Fort Chalkmoth first. 4. I still do not know what the Root and Eye really are, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or who the Collector is. I can learn by exploring.

answer Quest The Kings Gate is done. I am Toh-Wo, now Reel-Ka (Warrior) of the Toh-Reel-Ka, wearing the Reel-Ka cuirass and helm, about 1350 gold, rapier, lockpicks, 3 Unbound Seals, Recipe for the Seal, 3 Grey Seals, Pale Harvest key, disc, keystone, eye-setting. Meer-Tasi at Bell Station said the cut tower is Teku-Sul Spire. The ghost of Sul-Xeeth there said the great gate needs all three seal-stones: one in the warden vault at Blackrose Prison (least dangerous), one in the flooded vaults of Gemin, one in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (worst). The gate leads to the Root and the Eye. Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom wants all three before the Unbound. All three are marked on my map. I have free beds in Archwarden forts. Fort Chalkmoth errand (what moans in the cellar) is still open. Still unknown: what the Root and Eye really are, and who the Collector is.
